name: Venture firm
blurb: A venture firm's deals, portfolio, people and investment theses, with every signal tied to the beliefs it supports or contradicts.
about: Build a living operating record for a venture firm, and the agent workflows around it. It keeps deals, portfolio companies, people, meetings, investment theses and the evidence for and against them linked, so every decision traces back to the beliefs it rests on. New evidence is tied to the assumptions it supports or contradicts as it arrives. Agents prepare briefs, capture calls and propose lessons, and a partner reviews what they write.
sample: Quito Capital, a fictional AI-infrastructure fund

questions.q: Which active theses has new evidence contradicted?
